GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped fairly. Not pushed early & raced 4th 3 Wide With Cover (2.5L from lead). Stayed same until Four Wide @ 450m & pushed to quicken Six Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 250m & hit top @ 150m. Grabbed leaders late. # Wide/kept giving.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping and then blundered which resulted in its rider becoming unbalanced.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away evenly. Rolled fwd before raced keenly 3rd on inside (3L from lead) early . Raced keenly & Held Ground until pushed to quicken Two Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Two Wide @ 200m & outsprinted Two Wide in last 150m. # Did too much wrong
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early stages. Hung out whilst under pressure in the home straight. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well faced breeze half off, ridden along turn, joint lead Straightening Up , headed approaching 100m, kept on strong late # faced breeze
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 100m became unbalanced in its action. .

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well to lead 1 length clear, held together turn, Straightened Up 1 length clear, half clear passing 200m, headed approaching 100m and weakened sharply late # led/weak final 100m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Inclined to lay out under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bumped @ start Rolled fwd until shared lead on inside early . Stayed =lead on inside midrace & laid out =lead Two Wide on home turn. Pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 250m & pressured to lead @ 200m. Fought on until over-run in last 50m. # On-pace/tried hard.

Jumped well. Pushed fwd & shared lead 3 Wide No Cover early . Worked to hold ground midrace & held together =lead Four Wide on home turn. Pushed to quicken Four Wide @ 250m & pressured @ 250m. Fought on in last 150m but no match late. # Worked/tried hard.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three-wide and without cover throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat box seat 1 length off, off rail turn, Straightened Up 1 length off all clear, found little, kept on one pace # disappointing
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Commenced to hang out over the concluding stages and was unable to be fully tested for  the remainder of the event. A post-race veterinary examination.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well to lead 1 length clear 2 wide, held together turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths clear and kept going strong to the line increasing margin. # led/soft win

Slow away. Niggled early & recovered to raced keenly in lead on rail (1/2L clear). Held lead on inside until joined @ 500m. Pushed to quicken =lead 3 Wide on home turn. Pressured Four Wide @ 250m & raced greenly @ 200m. Laid in & faded in last 100m. # On-pace/faded.
Jumped Ok settled 4l off, same turn, Straightened Up 3-4l off, running on 2 Lengths off approaching 100m, kept finding the line late, just no match winner # found 1 better
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Hung out rounding the home turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Pushed fwd & raced behind leaders Two Wide (2L from lead) early . Tracked leaders Two Wide midrace & pushed to quicken Four Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 250m & worked home steadily in last 200m. # Sound debut
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted in and bumped. Was inclined to lay in under pressure in the home straight.
